guard/32185.htm.text: Marksman Peregrine: You have done well coming up here. This is the border between the Hills of Gold and Mimir's Forest; once you pass this place you will face powerful monsters in Mimir's Forest. Also, inside here is the Nornil's Garden, the Nornil's Cave and Kamael Village Harbor.
